notes.title: Content update
notes.content: [p]In Artificial Ignorance, you must lead your AI company to world domination and destroy the world along the way. New achievements, programs, and mechanics. The original game modes remain intact.[/p]

notes.title: Fatal error fix
notes.content:
This small update fixes a potential critical bug where, if the cloud save gets corrupted, the game might fail to run properly.

In that case, the game will now show a warning at startup indicating that the save is corrupted, and a new one will be created automatically.

I’ll keep working on this to add better protection and possibly a backup system for previous save files.

Sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Thanks!
notes.content:
[p]It’s been a few days since Infiniclick launched, and after the "initial shock" and bug fixing, I’ve finally had a chance to relax a little.[/p][p]Huge thanks to everyone who bought the game, and also to those who’ve shared feedback, both positive and negative (I really appreciate that almost everyone who gave negative feedback did so in a constructive way).[/p][p]I read all the comments and reviews, and I take them into account. I’ll keep working to improve the game.
Thank you so much![/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.9 - 6/21/2025
notes.content: [p]Now you can set the game in windowed mode in the options panel (only in the main menu). You can resize the window freely.[/p][p][/p][p]Two new songs added to the music loop.[/p][p][/p][p]Steam achievements bug fix.[/p]
